chapterInfo.content:
15
Honhom mu ahoteɛ
(Marko 7.1-23)
1Ɛnna Atwerɛfoɔ ne Farisifoɔ firi Yerusalem baa Yesu nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: 2#Deut 4.2; Luk 11.38 Adɛn nti na w’asuafoɔ no nni mpanimfoɔ atetesɛm no soɔ? Wɔnhohoro wɔn nsa ansa na wɔadidi. 3Na Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na mo nso mo atetesɛm nti, monni Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ soɔ? 4#Eks 20.12; 21.17 Na Onyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ: Di w’agya ne wo na ni, na deɛ ɔka agya anaa ɛna ho asɛmmɔne no, owuo na ma no nwuo. 5Na mo deɛ mose: Obiara a ɔbɛse n’agya anaa ne na sɛ: Deɛ anka wobɛnya no me hɔ no yɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ no, 6na ɛnni sɛ ɔdi n’agya anaa ne na ni, na mo atetesɛm nti moasɛe Nyankopɔn asɛm. 7#Yes 29.13 Nyaatwomfoɔ! Ɛdi sɛ Yesaia hyɛɛ mo ho nkɔm sɛ:
8 Ɔman yi de wɔn anofafa na ɛdi me ni,
na wɔn akoma deɛ, atwe afiri me ho kɔ akyirikyiri.
9 Na wɔsɔre me kwa,
wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a nnipa ahyehyɛ.
10Na ɔfrɛɛ nkurɔfokuo no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Montie, na monte aseɛ. 11#1 Ti 4.4; Mat 12.34 Ɛnyɛ deɛ ɛkɔ anomu na ɛgu onipa ho fi, na mmom deɛ ɛfiri anomu ba na ɛgu onipa ho fi. 12Ɛnna n’asuafoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wonim sɛ Farisifoɔ no tee asɛm yi no, ato wɔn suntidua? 13Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Dua biara a ɛnyɛ me soro Agya na ɔduaeɛ no, wɔbɛtu. 14#Mat 23.24; Luk 6.39; Rom 2.19 Monnyaa wɔn, wɔyɛ anifirafoɔ a wɔkyerɛ anifirafoɔ kwan; na sɛ onifirani kyerɛ onifirani kwan a, wɔn baanu nyinaa bɛtɔ amena mu. 15Na Petro bua see no sɛ: Kyerɛ yɛn bɛ no ase! 16Na ɔse: Mo nso moda so nte aseɛ ara? 17Monhunu sɛ adeɛ biara a ɛkɔ anomu no kɔ ɔyafunu mu na ɛyi gu yaane mu anaa? 18Na deɛ ɛfiri anomu firi adie deɛ, ɛfiri onipa akoma mu, na ɛno na ɛgu onipa ho fi. 19#Gye 8.21 Na akoma mu na adwemmɔne, awudisɛm, ayefasɛm, adwamansɛm, awifosɛm, adansekurumu ne abususɛm fire. 20Yeinom ne nnoɔma a ɛgu onipa ho fi; na sɛ wɔde nsa a wɔanhohorɔ didi a, ɛngu onipa ho fi.
Ababaa bosonsonni bi ayaresa
(Marko 7.24-30)
21Na Yesu firi hɔ kɔɔ Tiro ne Sidon fa mu. 22Na hwɛ, Kanaanni baa bi a ɔfiri mpɔtamu hɔ ba bɛteateaa mu sɛ: O Awurade, Dawid ba, hu me mmɔbɔ, na honhommɔne bi reha me babaa dodo! 23Nanso wammua no. Na n’asuafoɔ no ba bɛsrɛɛ no sɛ: Gya no kwan ma no nkɔ, na ɔreteateam di yɛn akyi. 24#Mat 10.6 Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Israel fie nnwan a wɔayera no nko ara nkyɛn na wɔsomaa me. 25Na ɔbaa no ba bɛkotoo no sɛ: Awurade, boa me! 26Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ fɛ sɛ wɔfa mma aduane to ma nkraman mma. 27Na ɔse: Ɛwom, Awurade, nanso nkraman mma no nso di mporoporowa a ɛfiri wɔn wuranom pono so gu fam no bi. 28#Mat 8.10; 8.13 Ɛnna Yesu bua see no sɛ: O, ɔbaa, wo gyidie so; ɛnyɛ mma wo sɛdeɛ wopɛ no. Na amonom hɔ ara ne babaa no ho yɛɛ no den.
Yesu sa nyarewa ahodoɔ
29 # Mar 7.31 Na Yesu firi hɔ baa Galilea po ho. Na ɔkɔɔ bepɔ so kɔtenaa ase wɔ hɔ. 30Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo pii de mpakye, mmubuafoɔ, anifirafoɔ, emum ne afoforɔ pii baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔde wɔn bɛguu ne nan ase, na ɔsaa wɔn yadeɛ 31#Mar 7.37 maa no yɛɛ nkurɔfokuo no nwanwa, berɛ a wɔhunuu sɛ emum rekasa, na mpakye ho sane, na mmubuafoɔ nanteɛ, na anifirafoɔ hunu adeɛ; na wɔhyɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn animuonyam.
Nnipa mpemnan aduanema
(Marko 8.1-10)
32 # Mat 14.14 Na Yesu frɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no see wɔn sɛ: Nkurɔfokuo yi yɛ me mmɔbɔ sɛ wɔatena me nkyɛn atoa so nnansa nie, na wɔnni biribi a wɔdie; nanso mempɛ sɛ megya wɔn kwan ma wɔde yafumpan korɔ, na wɔankɔtotɔ baha ɔkwan mu. 33Na asuafoɔ no see no sɛ: Ɛhe na yɛbɛnya paanoo a ɛbɛso nkurɔfokuo pii sɛɛ wɔ anwea pradada so ha? 34Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Paanoo ahe na mowɔ? Na wɔse: Nson ne mpataa nketewa bi. 35Na ɔhyɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no sɛ wɔntenatena fam. 36Na ɔfaa paanoo nson no ne mpataa no, na ɔdaa ase, na ɔbubu de maa n’asuafoɔ no, na asuafoɔ no nso de maa nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no. 37Na wɔn nyinaa di meeɛ, na wɔtasetasee mporoporowa a ɛkaeɛ no nkɛntɛn nson mama. 38Na wɔn a wɔdiiɛ no yɛ mmarima mpemnan a wɔankan mmaa ne mmɔfra anka ho. 39Na ɔgyaa nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no kwan no, ɔfaa kodoɔ na ɔbaa Magadan ahyeɛ so.

Ɛnna Atwerɛfoɔ ne Farisifoɔ firi Yerusalem baa Yesu nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Adɛn nti na w’asuafoɔ no nni mpanimfoɔ atetesɛm no soɔ? Wɔnhohoro wɔn nsa ansa na wɔadidi. Na Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na mo nso mo atetesɛm nti, monni Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ soɔ? Na Onyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ: Di w’agya ne wo na ni, na deɛ ɔka agya anaa ɛna ho asɛmmɔne no, owuo na ma no nwuo. Ɛdi sɛ Yesaia hyɛɛ mo ho nkɔm sɛ:
Ɔman yi de wɔn anofafa na ɛdi me ni,
na wɔn akoma deɛ, atwe afiri me ho kɔ akyirikyiri.
Na wɔsɔre me kwa,
wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a nnipa ahyehyɛ.
Na ɔfrɛɛ nkurɔfokuo no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Montie, na monte aseɛ. Ɛnyɛ deɛ ɛkɔ anomu na ɛgu onipa ho fi, na mmom deɛ ɛfiri anomu ba na ɛgu onipa ho fi. Ɛnna n’asuafoɔ no baa ne nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wonim sɛ Farisifoɔ no tee asɛm yi no, ato wɔn suntidua? Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Dua biara a ɛnyɛ me soro Agya na ɔduaeɛ no, wɔbɛtu. Monnyaa wɔn, wɔyɛ anifirafoɔ a wɔkyerɛ anifirafoɔ kwan; na sɛ onifirani kyerɛ onifirani kwan a, wɔn baanu nyinaa bɛtɔ amena mu. Na Petro bua see no sɛ: Kyerɛ yɛn bɛ no ase! Na ɔse: Mo nso moda so nte aseɛ ara? Monhunu sɛ adeɛ biara a ɛkɔ anomu no kɔ ɔyafunu mu na ɛyi gu yaane mu anaa? Na deɛ ɛfiri anomu firi adie deɛ, ɛfiri onipa akoma mu, na ɛno na ɛgu onipa ho fi. Na akoma mu na adwemmɔne, awudisɛm, ayefasɛm, adwamansɛm, awifosɛm, adansekurumu ne abususɛm fire. Yeinom ne nnoɔma a ɛgu onipa ho fi; na sɛ wɔde nsa a wɔanhohorɔ didi a, ɛngu onipa ho fi.


Na Yesu firi hɔ kɔɔ Tiro ne Sidon fa mu. Na hwɛ, Kanaanni baa bi a ɔfiri mpɔtamu hɔ ba bɛteateaa mu sɛ: O Awurade, Dawid ba, hu me mmɔbɔ, na honhommɔne bi reha me babaa dodo! Nanso wammua no. Na n’asuafoɔ no ba bɛsrɛɛ no sɛ: Gya no kwan ma no nkɔ, na ɔreteateam di yɛn akyi. Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Israel fie nnwan a wɔayera no nko ara nkyɛn na wɔsomaa me. Na ɔbaa no ba bɛkotoo no sɛ: Awurade, boa me! Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ fɛ sɛ wɔfa mma aduane to ma nkraman mma. Na ɔse: Ɛwom, Awurade, nanso nkraman mma no nso di mporoporowa a ɛfiri wɔn wuranom pono so gu fam no bi. Ɛnna Yesu bua see no sɛ: O, ɔbaa, wo gyidie so; ɛnyɛ mma wo sɛdeɛ wopɛ no. Na amonom hɔ ara ne babaa no ho yɛɛ no den.

Na Yesu firi hɔ baa Galilea po ho. Na ɔkɔɔ bepɔ so kɔtenaa ase wɔ hɔ. Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo pii de mpakye, mmubuafoɔ, anifirafoɔ, emum ne afoforɔ pii baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔde wɔn bɛguu ne nan ase, na ɔsaa wɔn yadeɛ maa no yɛɛ nkurɔfokuo no nwanwa, berɛ a wɔhunuu sɛ emum rekasa, na mpakye ho sane, na mmubuafoɔ nanteɛ, na anifirafoɔ hunu adeɛ; na wɔhyɛɛ Israel Nyankopɔn animuonyam.


Na Yesu frɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no see wɔn sɛ: Nkurɔfokuo yi yɛ me mmɔbɔ sɛ wɔatena me nkyɛn atoa so nnansa nie, na wɔnni biribi a wɔdie; nanso mempɛ sɛ megya wɔn kwan ma wɔde yafumpan korɔ, na wɔankɔtotɔ baha ɔkwan mu. Na asuafoɔ no see no sɛ: Ɛhe na yɛbɛnya paanoo a ɛbɛso nkurɔfokuo pii sɛɛ wɔ anwea pradada so ha? Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Paanoo ahe na mowɔ? Na wɔse: Nson ne mpataa nketewa bi. Na ɔhyɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no sɛ wɔntenatena fam. Na ɔfaa paanoo nson no ne mpataa no, na ɔdaa ase, na ɔbubu de maa n’asuafoɔ no, na asuafoɔ no nso de maa nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no. Na wɔn nyinaa di meeɛ, na wɔtasetasee mporoporowa a ɛkaeɛ no nkɛntɛn nson mama. Na wɔn a wɔdiiɛ no yɛ mmarima mpemnan a wɔankan mmaa ne mmɔfra anka ho. Na ɔgyaa nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no kwan no, ɔfaa kodoɔ na ɔbaa Magadan ahyeɛ so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
